verses.en: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.sm: Koru. O lona faavae o i le atu mauga paia lea.

verses.en: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.sm: E sili le fiafia o Je Arun: i faitotoa o Siona, i lona fiafia i mea uma e nonofo ai Iakopo.

verses.en: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
verses.sm: O meae viia ua taʻua lava ia te oe, le aai a le Atua. Sela.

verses.en: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
verses.sm: Ou re taʻua Raava ma Papelonia faatasi ma e ua iloa au; faauta, O Filisitia, ma Turo, atoa ma Aitiope; na fanau ai lenei tagata.

verses.en: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.sm: E faapea ane foi ia Siona, O lea tagata ma lea tagata na fanau ai; o lē Silisili ese foi, o ia lea na te faatumauina o ia.

verses.en: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
verses.sm: Ole Atu na te faitauina pe a tusia e ia le nuu, e faapea ane, Na fanau ai lenei tagata. Sela.

verses.en: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
verses.sm: O e pepese atoa ma e sisiva; o ia te oe oʻu punávai uma.
